facts: qwen3.7-plus-2026-05-26 accepts text, image, and video input and returns text.
The frozen Beijing snapshot exposes a 1,000,000-token context window and a 131,072-token maximum output in both thinking and non-thinking modes.
The frozen model supports thinking mode and structured output.
Qwen3.7-Plus series supports JSON Schema structured output.
JSON Schema mode uses response_format type json_schema with an embedded named schema and strict true.
JSON Schema mode enforces the declared structure and does not require the prompt to contain the word JSON.

The official production guidance recommends omitting max_tokens to avoid truncated invalid JSON; this run instead owner-locks max_completion_tokens and treats truncation or invalid JSON as a terminal non-parsed result.
qwen3.7-plus-2026-05-26 is a hybrid-thinking model and supports enable_thinking true.
Reasoning tokens are included in output-token usage and are billed as output tokens.
Commercial Qwen thinking models support non-streaming synchronous output.
In the OpenAI-compatible Chat API, max_tokens limits only the answer and excludes chain-of-thought.
max_completion_tokens limits the complete model output, including chain-of-thought and answer.
Qwen Plus models from Qwen3.5 onward support max_completion_tokens.
The documented actual total output may exceed max_completion_tokens by up to 10 tokens because the last inference iteration is retained.
China Beijing list pricing for the frozen model is CNY 2 per million input tokens and CNY 8 per million output tokens when request input is at most 256,000 tokens.
The documented output price is the same for non-thinking and thinking modes in this tier.
No discount, free quota, cache discount, or batch discount is assumed.
